q.line: With his faithful slave, Pedro, behind him, he tramps
stanza: The king of the Philistines, his soldiers to save
Puts jawbones on their tombstones and flatters their graves
Puts the pied pipers in prison and fattens the slaves
Then sends them out to the jungle
Gypsy Davey, with a blowtorch, he burns out their camps
With his faithful slave, Pedro, behind him, he tramps
With a fantastic collection of stamps
To win friends and influence his uncle

partner.line: Gypsy Davey, with a blowtorch, he burns out their camps

q.songTitle: Is This the Life We Really Want?
